notes.title: Small QOL update for the presets
notes.notes:
Added two small features :
[list]
[*] It is now not necessary to switch to another preset to apply the last selected
[*] Clicking anywhere outside the preset box (within the application) will close the preset box
[/list]

notes.title: Presets update!
notes.notes:
It is now possible to create your own custom presets for Volmatic!

Those presets will enable you to save the following settings :
[list]
[*] The intensity (Volmatic's main slider)
[*] The slow correction toggle
[*] The boost intensity
[*] The slow correction speed
[*] The maximum volume if you are using headphones
[/list]

By clicking on this button :

[img]https://i.imgur.com/qeUn7G2.png[/img]


You will open the presets management options :

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Y41YKcm.png[/img]


The way it works is pretty straightforward :
[list]
[*] Clic on a preset to apply it.
[*] Clic add to add a preset with the current settings and the name typed in the text box.
[*] Clic remove to remove a preset having the same name as the one in the text box (clicking on a preset will copy its name into it).
[*] If a preset with the same name already exists, it will update the existing one.
[/list]

Have fun :)

Volmatic's dev.

notes.title: Small performance patch
notes.notes: More controlled refresh rate in order to prevent a rare throttling issue.

notes.title: Application filtering update!
notes.notes:
[h2]As a popular request, the possibility to exclude specific applications from the volume control has been added!
[/h2]


You can now find that option in the advanced settings by clicking on the gear icon :

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38915162/33d90de395267e7af5df27e37a57b509c712dd89.png[/img]

The advanced settings now look like this :

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38915162/7feea429bb68e68321b974f9c94407a6fa332994.png[/img]


In order to exclude an application, first enable the switch below the "Application exclusion" text.
Then add your app by simply clicking on it in the first list.


[b]If your application does not appear in the list :
[/b]- Make sure you started it so it can be detected
- Make it make some noise (not always necessary)
- Press the refresh button


After clicking on it, it will appear on the second list. Clicking on it there will un-filter it and submit it again to Volmatic control.


[h2]What about the help that was displayed in the advanced settings?[/h2]


A question mark icon can now be clicked from the main window. It will then open the new help page.

[h1]Happy new year to everyone![/h1]
